summary: Scales the input float by 3.0, truncates it to an integer, and packs the result into the upper 10 bits (bits 22-31) of the dword at this+0x30 while preserving its lower 22 bits with the mask 0xFF3FFFFF. Stores the combined value back to this+0x30 and returns it.

local_names.a2: source float scaled and truncated before packing
local_names.result: combined dword: (int)v3 shifted to bits 22-31 OR the preserved lower 22 bits of this+0x30

operations.description: Scale the input: v3 = a2 * 3.0 (packet flags flt_59E478 as the floating constant behind this multiply).
Truncate and shift: (int)v3 << 22 places the integer into bits 22-31 of the result dword.
Mask the existing field: this[12] & 0xFF3FFFFF preserves the lower 22 bits of the dword at this+0x30.
Combine and store: result = ((int)v3 << 22) | (this[12] & 0xFF3FFFFF), then this[12] = result.
Return the updated dword stored at this+0x30.
Invoked by SetupCarLightingAndRender (004C71C0) to write a scaled float into the 10-bit field at this+0x30 as part of car lighting setup.
